fields.Fee Scope: Published two-year MBA programme fee. Hostel, living costs and any separately quoted charges excluded; confirm the offer-letter cycle.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, NMAT, ATMA or GMAT, per the official Gurugram MBA FAQ.
fields.Eligibility: Recognised bachelor’s degree. The official Gurugram FAQ requires at least 55% each in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation. Final-year candidates may apply provisionally.
fields.Selection Process: Profile screening considers academics, entrance scores and experience; management selection includes personal interview, simulation and case study. Final decision considers overall profile.
